_comment: FX blocks = building bricks of GoleM chains. `plugin` = name for TrackFX_AddByName on the Reaper side (adjust to the install). `engine`: 'plugin' (FX in the chain) or 'midi' (Whammy DT driven over MIDI out, not a plugin). Params are normalized 0..1 on the Reaper side (we store an indicative default).
_renamed_comment: v31 — per-param `renamed: {old label: new label}` on an enum whose LABELS changed while its values did not (delay-tape time: '1/4' played a sixteenth). bridge/option_renames.py rewrites old labels on load (presets, patches, block presets, Designer sandbox); an old label is never a new option (tests/test_option_renames.py), so the rewrite is pure and idempotent.
_tunings_comment: v28 — the Tuner block carries `params.tuning` = an id of library/catalog/tunings.json (a COPY of golem.fm's TUNING_PRESETS: same ids). The list offered follows the lane role (guitar = 6/7/8-string, bass = 4/5-string); empty = the role default (6-std / bass-4-std). The /live tuner shows one chip per string of that tuning.
_bench_comment: Per-block `bench` (v26) = the block has NOT yet passed the engine-stall bench (tools/check-block-stall.py: does switching it on/off freeze Reaper?). Only value: "pending". The rack Designer still offers the block (a person can try it); golem.fm's AI must NOT propose it. The key is REMOVED once the bench concludes clean; a block that fails goes to `quarantine` instead. Never infer it from the plugin family: it is measured, block by block.
_exp_comment: Per-param `exp: true` (v21) = a knob worth putting on the EXP pedal. The rack Designer shows the EXP chip ONLY on those knobs for a block that declares any (a block without the flag keeps the chip on every knob), and the Assign modal targets the first one. golem.fm's AI reads the same flag. `depends: {param: value}` = the knob only acts when that other param has that value (shown greyed otherwise).
_pedals_comment: Named pedal ARCHETYPES (docs/archive/named-pedals.md) — each is a pedal-nam block pre-bound to a TONE3000 capture search. `match` = T3K query (gear=pedal). Adding one opens the capture picker pre-filtered (installed + downloadable). Pure DATA: the engine block stays type 'pedal-nam' + variant=id. Grows without code.
_amps_comment: Named AMP archetypes — same mechanism as pedals but block 'amp' (gear amp-cab = full amp+cab capture). Adding one opens the capture picker pre-filtered to that amp's TONE3000 captures.

role_blocks._comment: The EXACT blocks a lane ROLE is offered, within its role_categories — the finer sieve (2026-09-17: a drums lane must get blocks that suit a kit, sorted like guitar or voice). A role absent here sees every block of its categories (guitar, bass, voice, keys…). Read by the rack Designer drawer, golem.fm's drawer and the AI vocabulary; kept in one place, in data. drums = the kit instrument, dynamics (gate/comp/captured comp/limiter), a captured preamp, Grit, the three EQs, the two studio modulations that belong on drums (flanger, phaser), delays (slapback), room/plate/hall reverbs, level and bitcrusher — never amp, cab, drive, wah, pitch, tuner, tremolo, rotary, vibrato, ring mod, granular, shimmer, spring.

role_categories._comment: Categories offered to each lane ROLE — the add-block drawer (rack Designer AND golem.fm) and the AI vocabulary read THIS table; guitar and line: every category except drums (the Drum Kit is the drums lane's instrument — offered on a guitar lane it only showed a greyed tile, 2026-10-25); a role absent here sees every category. voice: vocal FX + captured outboard + lofi (Grit, the ONLY saturation allowed on a voice) — never amp, cab or drive. keys/pads: instruments + keyboard-coherent FX (no wah, no pitch, no amp). drums (docs/drums-kit.md): an electronic kit — the Drum Kit instrument (category drums, lot 2), then dynamics, preamp, lofi, eq, modulation, delay, reverb, utility; never amp, cab, drive, filter or pitch.

effects.name: Noise Gate
effects.note: Noise gate pedal-grade (ReaGate). Sidechain filters shape what the gate LISTENS to (hipass keeps low rumble from opening it) ; hysteresis separates open/close thresholds (no chatter). Block presets: Soft / Standard / Chug-tight.

effects.name: Compressor
effects.note: ReaComp — Makeup = Wet port (dB); Auto Make Up Gain forced OFF on insert (FX_INIT golem_rig).

effects.name: Overdrive / Boost
effects.note: GuitarML Proteus (confirmed on the rig) — Drive/Level ports 0..1 (scale), B/M/T ±8 raw.

effects.name: Pedal (NAM capture)
effects.note: A real PEDAL actually scanned (TONE3000 gear=pedal) loaded into a NAM instance, placed before the amp. Input = drive level into the pedal (very expressive, 🦶-able). Input = the capture's gain knob (push to saturate, pull to clean up) — stay within ±6 dB, the model's training range. Output is a pure trim (loudness-normalized at compile).

effects.name: Preamp (NAM capture)
effects.note: A real PREAMP or channel strip actually scanned (TONE3000 gear=outboard, .nam) loaded into a NAM instance. Head of the chain, right after the gate: gate → preamp → deesser → pitch → comp → eq → delay/reverb. One per lane. Input = the capture's gain knob (push to saturate, pull to clean up) — stay within ±6 dB, the model's training range. Output is a pure trim (loudness-normalized at compile, like an amp). Packs with one model per gain setting drive the Capture dial.

effects.name: Compressor (NAM capture)
effects.note: A real COMPRESSOR/limiter actually scanned (TONE3000 gear=outboard, .nam) loaded into a NAM instance. Takes the place of the Compressor block (two dynamics stages max in series). Input = how hard the capture is hit (its threshold, in effect) — stay within ±6 dB, the model's training range. Output is a pure trim (loudness-normalized at compile).

effects.name: Grit (multiband distortion)
effects.note: Prisma (UnplugRed, AGPL, built from source by provision/install-prisma.sh): 4 bands, 2 exposed modules per band (Soft/Hard clip, Heavy, Fold, Bit crush, Sample divide, Lowpass, Ring mod, Cabinet…), crossovers, per-band gain, wet. The Trash-style tool: dirty the mids, keep lows clean, no fizz on top. VOICE: after the de-esser (saturation multiplies sibilance), before the compressor; a preset (Grit / Megaphone / Telephone / Broken) on a footswitch. Keep Quality OFF live: zero latency.

effects.name: Kill Switch

params.name: Depth (%)
params.label: Depth
params.note: how much each cut kills: 100 % = the real toggle (silence), less = a hard chop that leaves some signal. On the EXP pedal: heel = no effect, toe = full kill — the stutter comes in with the foot, no stomp needed

params.name: Length (%)
params.label: Length
params.note: share of each step where the sound PASSES (the rest is cut). Low = short blips, high = the cuts become flickers. On the EXP pedal: staccato to legato

params.name: Sync
params.label: Sync
params.note: one step per subdivision of the preset BPM (the BPM is the quarter note). Free = Rate in Hz

params.name: Rate (Hz)
params.label: Rate
params.note: steps per second when Sync = Free. On the EXP pedal: the machine-gun sweep (slow to frantic)

params.name: Trigger
params.label: Trigger
params.note: when the cycle restarts, always on an OPEN step. Engage = when the block turns on (scene, stomp). Pick = on every pick attack heard at the block's input (the chop follows the hand; place it before the amp). Beat = on the song grid while the transport plays (backing track), else like Engage

params.name: Pick sensitivity (%)
params.label: Sens
params.note: Pick trigger only: 0 % = only hard attacks (12 dB rise above -30 dBFS), 100 % = light touches (2 dB above -60 dBFS)

params.name: Smooth (ms)
params.label: Smooth
params.note: ramp of each cut: 0 = the dry click of a real toggle switch, a few ms = cuts without clicks

effects.note: GoleM JSFX (reaper/Effects/golem_killswitch.jsfx, MIT): the kill-switch technique — the sound is CUT then given back in rhythm, not faded like a tremolo. Tempo-synced to the preset BPM (1/4 to 1/32, triplets) or free in Hz; each step starts OPEN (the note lands on the beat, the hole comes after). Placement: guitar/bass before the amp = the real toggle on the guitar (amp noise included, and the Pick trigger hears clean attacks), after the amp = cleaner, harder cuts; always BEFORE delay/reverb so the tails ring through the cuts. Voice: after comp/EQ, before delay/reverb (stutter vocal). Usual use: a stomp or a scene that engages it (Depth 100, 1/16), or leave it on and put Depth on the EXP pedal. Zero latency, no negative-min slider (EXP-safe). Guitar, bass and voice only (roles).
effects._validation: 2026-09-22 : VALIDÉ sur le rig — fxadd sous les deux noms, check-block-stall 0 gel (max 2 ms), banc gapmeter (1/16 à 120 BPM = 125,00 ms, 1/8T 166,7, 1/32 62,5, Free 10 Hz 100,0), deux vraies reconstructions (seul puis derrière un gate), 7 potards écrits en brut au bon index, override de scène, EXP 0/64/127 -> Depth 0/50/100, pid Reaper inchangé. Trigger Pick : zéro fausse attaque sur un ton continu, PAS encore validé sous les doigts.

effects.name: Tuner
effects.note: Bloc-MARQUEUR (doctrine 2026-07-20) : surface UI + claim de pied, jamais matérialisé (runtime = JSFX système golem_tuner). Posé dans une lane, il désigne la source écoutée. foot_scene_claim : assignable aux switches 1-5 (remplace le slot de scène).

effects.name: Rec
effects.note: Bloc-MARQUEUR (doctrine 2026-07-20) : start/stop de l'enregistrement de performance (Library ▸ Loops) au pied. Assignable stomps 6-10 OU rangée scènes (foot_scene_claim). Remplace perf_foot (lu en legacy). Sources : coches IN 1 / IN 2 / USB dans la fiche (params.in1/in2/usb, défaut tout) — backing & looper toujours inclus (le mix entendu).

effects.name: Click
effects.note: Bloc-SERVICE permanent (lane Recorder, chantier Click 2026-07-25) : métronome free-running (piste Click + golem_click.jsfx) qui suit le BPM du preset, tique transport arrêté, et sort sur le rôle 'click' du patch de la carte (défaut : monitors — jamais gravé dans les prises perf-rec). Config GLOBALE (config/click.json) comme le bloc Rec. On/off au pied via claim.

effects.name: Riff
effects.note: Permanent marker block (docs/compo.md): a RIFF sent to the golem.fm composer. Displayed "Riff" — "comp" reads as the compressor; the id `compo` never shows and stays in the golem.fm contract, the `compo-target` uplink command and config/compo.json. Gesture: tap = start a capture (through the Rec take path, with the Rec block's count-in), tap = stop; a second tap during the count-in cancels. Same tap from the footswitch, the screen or a Companion (POST /api/compo/tap), and golem.fm can start/stop it remotely. After the stop the rack holds the take 20 s before sending; Drop is ON SCREEN only (/live). There is no long press, no double tap and no retro-capture (keep the last N seconds) yet: proposed, not coded. GLOBAL config (config/compo.json) like Rec and Click: each person's lanes, transcription on the rack; only the footswitch is per preset. The author = the person of the device that taps (footswitch: foot_person, Companion: its device). "Follow Golem" target received through the uplink (compo-target, per person, in memory).

effects.name: Sample
effects.note: Lanceur de one-shots au pied (bloc-marqueur, doctrine 2026-07-21). foot_scene_claim : occupe un switch de la 1re rangee ; NON-unique (plusieurs lanceurs). Geste : TAP = coupe le sample en cours + lance le SUIVANT de la liste (repos = le premier ; liste d'un seul = retrigger) ; APPUI LONG = stop. One-shot : chaque sample joue jusqu'au bout ou jusqu'au prochain tap/stop. Cycle. scene-invariant (un sample lance survit au changement de scene). Audio via RS5k (golem_sample.lua).

effects.name: Drum Machine
effects.note: Boite a rythmes au pied (bloc-marqueur, doctrine 2026-07-21, approche B). Joue des patterns MIDI de batterie en BOUCLE synchro-tempo a travers un kit RS5k. foot_scene_claim ; NON-unique ; scene-invariant. Geste : ARRETE+tap = play ; EN COURS+tap = FILL (instantane, revient au groove) ; EN COURS+appui 0,6-1,5 s = VARIATION (partie suivante, a la mesure) ; EN COURS+appui >=1,5 s = STOP. Synchro sur le BPM du preset. Audio via golem_drums.lua.

effects.name: Standard

params.name: Live view
params._note: UI seulement — la page /live lit ce param pour savoir quoi rendre. Pas de `map` : rien ne descend vers Reaper.

effects.note: Bloc-SERVICE (contrat docs/standards.md) : joue la GRILLE d'accords d'un standard — piano (voicings sans fondamentale, conduite des voix) + walking bass — pendant que le musicien joue le theme. UNIQUE ; scene-invariant (la tonalite d'un standard ne change pas au refrain) ; foot_scene_claim (un switch = play/stop). NE PORTE PAS DE TEMPO : preset.bpm est LA source de verite (le bloc l'AMORCE au chargement avec le tempo conventionnel du standard, et c'est fini). La FORME (chorus, solos, coda) appartient au bloc arrangement, pas ici. Pas de guitare SOLO : la lane guitare est l'entree du musicien, et le guitariste c'est toi ; la seule guitare du bloc est la POMPE manouche (parts.guitar, piste Standard Guitar, docs/standards.md §10). Moteur : bridge/standards.py rend les evenements -> golem_chordseq.lua les pose en gmem -> golem_chordseq.jsfx les emet a l'echantillon pres (ReaScript ne peut pas injecter du MIDI dans une instance FX precise). CONFLITS : backing-track et drums. Un preset EST un morceau, et un morceau est soit un backing soit un standard ; et le standard porte DEJA sa batterie (parts.drums), donc une boite a rythmes a cote ferait deux batteurs. Le tiroir d'ajout les grise dans les deux sens et dit pourquoi.

effects.name: Arrangement

params.name: Live view
params._note: UI seulement. Défaut Pedalboard : un arrangement bascule les scènes tout seul, la pastille de la rangée haute suffit — le pupitre (Timeline) est le besoin du BATTEUR, donc du mode Show, ou une demande explicite ici.

effects.note: Bloc CHEF D'ORCHESTRE (docs/arrangement.md, genre inaugure le 2026-07-30). Donne au preset - donc au morceau - sa structure dans le temps : une suite de SECTIONS (intro/verse/chorus...), chacune portant les CUES qui s'appliquent quand elle commence. IL NE FABRIQUE AUCUN SON : il sequence des scenes, la granularite par instrument EST la scene. Aucune piste Reaper (moteur dans le bridge). PERMANENT et SANS TIROIR (decision 2026-07-30) : il a son propre ONGLET du Designer, l'icone ▤ apres le ⚙ - le corps du Designer fait 481 px contre 257 pour un tiroir, et l'edition passait par cinq niveaux. Le bloc reste la donnee (config.arr), le switch au pied et le on/off ; l'onglet est son editeur. Metrique par section (7/8, 9/4) avec heritage section -> arrangement -> 4/4.

Retiré du tiroir, du vocabulaire de l'IA et de la compile jusqu'à correctif.

effects.name: Spring Reverb

effects.name: Frequency Shifter
effects.note: Surge XT Frequency Shifter (FX Type 7) — NOT a pitch shifter : shifts ALL partials by N Hz (inharmonic). Small shift + feedback = barberpole. 0.5 = no shift. Indexes verified against Surge source.

effects.name: Treemonster
effects.note: Surge XT Treemonster (FX Type 24) — pitch-tracking ring-mod mono-synth. FIX 2026-07-23: the exposed 'Pitch' knob actually drove High Cut (index 3) — Pitch is index 4. Indexes verified against Surge source.

effects.name: Spectral Comp
effects.plugin: CLAP: Spectral Compressor (Robbert van der Helm)

params.name: Global Threshold
params.label: Threshold
params.note: the level above which every bin is compressed (and below which it is expanded upwards). Start around the level of your quietest note

params.name: Downwards Ratio
params.label: Down
params.note: compression of the bins ABOVE the threshold — the tamer. 1:1 = off

params.name: Upwards Ratio
params.label: Up
params.note: expansion of the bins BELOW the threshold — brings up what is quiet, bin by bin. High values on a pad = pink noise; 1:1 = off

params.name: Threshold Center
params.label: Center
params.note: the pivot of the threshold curve across the spectrum

params.name: Threshold Slope
params.label: Slope
params.note: tilts the threshold: negative = the highs are compressed sooner (de-harsh), positive = the lows are

params.name: Window Size
params.label: Window
params.note: the FFT window — and the LATENCY: 2048 = 43 ms at 48 kHz. Smaller = tighter but blurrier in the lows (values = the plugin's raw order − 6 : 1024/2048/4096 ; the raw port is 0..9)

effects.note: Spectral Compressor (Robbert van der Helm, GPL-3, nih-plug — built from source by provision/install-spectral.sh, docs/spectral.md): a compressor per FFT bin (thousands of them), downwards AND upwards, with a threshold CURVE across the spectrum instead of one number. What it is for on a rack: even out a voice or a pad without pumping (the threshold follows the spectrum), hold a synth pad, 'pink-noise' a source with Up high. LATENCY = the window (2048 → 43 ms, compensated by Reaper's PDC on the lane): never in the base path of a guitar lane; voice, keys and pads take it. Placement: after gate/EQ, before delay/reverb. Knobs are written in NORMALIZED with the plugin's own tapers (map.mode pow, nih-plug Skewed/SymmetricalSkewed): a read-back in the same call is stale on nih-plug, so no display dichotomy here. `defaults: compile` — the catalog defaults are written at compile time when a preset omits them (the plugin's own defaults would leave Spectral Comp at 1:1 and Stretch with the direct signal cut).
effects._validation: 2026-09-25 : VALIDÉ au banc — fxadd sous « CLAP: Spectral Compressor (Robbert van der Helm) », pdc=2048 samples déclaré, check-block-stall : aucun gel (les −41…−47 ms mesurés sont le PDC qui entre, pas un gel), deux reconstructions (seul derrière un gate, puis rappel d'un autre preset et retour), les 10 potards relus à la valeur AFFICHÉE attendue (map.mode pow — la dichotomie d'affichage posait Window 32768 pour 2048, Attack 0,1 ms pour 50 : relecture en retard sur nih-plug), défauts du catalogue écrits à la compile. Pas encore joué à l'oreille.

effects.name: Stretch

params.name: Capture
params.label: Capture
params.note: ON: the input is recorded (up to Max length). OFF: the recording is committed and played back, looped and stretched. A stomp on this = a spectral looper

params.name: Freeze
params.label: Freeze
params.note: holds the playback position: the sound stays on one instant of the capture

params.name: Pass input through
params.label: Dry thru
params.note: lets the direct signal through the block. OFF = only the stretched playback (the plugin's own default — an insert that swallows the direct is a silence you would chase all night, hence ON here)

params.name: Stretch amount
params.label: Stretch
params.note: how much slower the capture plays: ×1 = real time, ×4 = a pad, ×50+ = a drone. Up to ×1024 inside the plugin

params.name: Frequency shift
params.label: F-shift
params.note: linear shift of every partial — inharmonic, bell-like at small values

params.name: Frequency spread
params.label: Spread
params.note: smears the partials into a wash (enables the spread module in the plugin when > 0)

params.name: Compress
params.label: Compress
params.note: spectral compression of the stretched sound: evens the partials, louder tail

params.name: FFT size
params.label: Grain
params.note: window size: low = tight and rhythmic, high = smooth and smeared

params.name: Enable spread
params.label: Spread on
params.note: the plugin's spread module switch — on, so the Spread knob does something

params.name: Enable compressor
params.label: Comp on
params.note: the plugin's spectral compressor module switch — on, so the Compress knob does something

effects.note: PaulXStretch (Jesse Chappell / Sonosaurus, GPL-3, after Nasca Octavian Paul's Paulstretch — built from source by provision/install-spectral.sh, docs/spectral.md). Not a continuous effect: a CAPTURE-AND-STRETCH instrument. Capture ON records the input, Capture OFF commits it and plays it back looped, stretched through the spectral modules (pitch, frequency shift, spread, compress); Freeze holds one instant. What it is for: the pad of an intro pulled from one chord, a drone under a verse, a voice stretched into the outro. Latency 0 on the direct; the stretched sound is by nature seconds behind. Placement: last in the lane, before or after reverb. Capture and Freeze are the two foot gestures (a stomp on Capture = a spectral looper). Knobs are written in NORMALIZED with the plugin's own tapers (map.mode pow): these plugins apply a parameter on the audio thread, a read-back in the same call is stale, so no display dichotomy here. `defaults: compile` — the catalog defaults are written at compile time when a preset omits them (the plugin's own defaults would leave Spectral Comp at 1:1 and Stretch with the direct signal cut).
effects._validation: 2026-09-25 : VALIDÉ au banc — fxadd sous « CLAP: PaulXStretch (Sonosaurus) », pdc=0, check-block-stall : aucun gel (max 2 ms), deux reconstructions, les 13 potards relus à la valeur affichée attendue (map.mode pow ; Stretch amount suit le skew 0,25 de JUCE), interrupteurs de module (spread/compress) posés par la compile, direct laissé passer par défaut. Pas encore joué à l'oreille ; le geste Capture au pied reste à valider.

effects.name: Freeze

params.name: Freeze
params.label: Freeze
params.note: the gesture: ON captures the chord and holds it, OFF lets it go in Decay. The block's footswitch drives THIS parameter (never the bypass): the direct always passes, the release tail rings

params.name: Mix
params.label: Mix
params.note: level of the held sound under the direct. On the EXP pedal: bring the pad in with the foot

params.name: Decay
params.label: Decay
params.note: how long the held sound takes to fade once released

params.name: Smear
params.label: Smear
params.note: phase jitter per frame: 0 = pure and a bit metallic, high = a soft cloud

params.name: Tone
params.label: Tone
params.note: tilt of the held spectrum: below 50 darker, above 50 brighter (±6 dB/oct around 1 kHz)

params.name: Window
params.label: Window
params.note: the FFT window — and the LATENCY: 2048 = 43 ms at 48 kHz. 1024 = tighter, 4096 = smoother on low chords

effects.note: GoleM Freeze (our own, GPL-3, plugins/golem_freeze on nih-plug — built by provision/install-spectral.sh, docs/spectral.md §3): the EHX Freeze gesture, spectral. Tap the switch: the chord you are holding is captured (4 frames averaged) and HELD — play over it; tap again: it fades in Decay. The direct always passes; the freeze is added under it. Freeze is a PARAMETER driven by the footswitch (golem_rig.fx_set_on), never the bypass. LATENCY = the window (2048 → 43 ms, Reaper's PDC on the lane): never in the base path of a guitar lane — on a branch, or on voice/keys/pads. Placement: after amp/cab, before delay/reverb (the tails stretch naturally).
effects._validation: 2026-09-25 : VALIDÉ au banc — fxadd sous « CLAP: GoleM Freeze (GoleM) », pdc=2048 (1024 avec Window 1024) déclaré, check-block-stall : aucun gel (max 3 ms), TENUE MESURÉE au crête-mètre (ton −20 dB en tête de lane, gel enclenché, ton coupé : −20,9 / −20,6 / −21,8 dB à +0,5 / +2 / +4 s ; sans gel −93 dB ; relâché : −41 dB à +0,6 s, −81 dB à +3 s), rig : scène A/B et stomp actionnent le PARAMÈTRE Freeze (FX toujours actif, latence stable), 6 potards relus à la valeur affichée, deux reconstructions. Pas encore joué à l'oreille (le timbre du gel : smear/tone à régler sous les doigts).

effects.name: Guitar Drive
effects.note: REAPER stock JSFX guitar/distortion. Max Volume shapes soft saturation; it is not a brickwall limiter.

_color_note: Couleurs des blocs de la lane CONFIG (onglet ⚙ du Designer), 2026-09-18 : trois familles, par ce que le service FAIT. JOUE (entre dans le mix) = vert, du plus enregistré (backing #1ab7b0) au plus fabriqué (standard #9ad9be) ; CAPTE (part sur le disque) = rouge (rec #ff4136, riff #ff7a45) ; COMPTE LE TEMPS = ambre (click #e0b23a, arrangement #c98a2e). Une nuance par bloc pour le distinguer, jamais une couleur étrangère : la lane se lit comme un groupe, le bloc comme un individu.
